## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    // The Gaussian density at value: phi(z) / sigma where z is the standardized
    // score (value - mean) / sigma. Exact.
    Pdf(self: NormalDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => StandardNormalPdf((value - self.Mean) / self.StandardDeviation)
         / self.StandardDeviation;

    // The cumulative probability at value, as the standard normal CDF of the
    // standardized score. Inherits the 7.5e-8 error bound of StandardNormalCdf.
    Cdf(self: NormalDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => StandardNormalCdf((value - self.Mean) / self.StandardDeviation);

    //==
    // # LogNormalDistribution
    //
    // Parameterization: LogMean (mu) and LogStandardDeviation (sigma) are the
    // mean and STANDARD DEVIATION OF THE UNDERLYING NORMAL, i.e. of ln(X), not
    // of X. Support is x > 0. Precondition: LogStandardDeviation > 0.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log-normal_distribution

    // The mean of the variable itself: exp(mu + sigma^2 / 2).
    Mean(self: LogNormalDistribution): Number
        => (self.LogMean + self.LogStandardDeviation.Square / 2.0).Exp;

    // The variance of the variable itself:
    // (exp(sigma^2) - 1) * exp(2*mu + sigma^2).
    Variance(self: LogNormalDistribution): Number
        => (self.LogStandardDeviation.Square.Exp - 1.0)
         * (2.0 * self.LogMean + self.LogStandardDeviation.Square).Exp;

    // The density at value: phi((ln v - mu) / sigma) / (v * sigma) for v > 0,
    // and zero on the non-positive half line. Exact.
    Pdf(self: LogNormalDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : StandardNormalPdf((value.NaturalLog - self.LogMean) / self.LogStandardDeviation)
                / (value * self.LogStandardDeviation);

    // The cumulative probability at value: Phi((ln v - mu) / sigma) for v > 0,
    // zero otherwise. Inherits the StandardNormalCdf error bound.
    Cdf(self: LogNormalDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : StandardNormalCdf((value.NaturalLog - self.LogMean) / self.LogStandardDeviation);

    //==
    // # ExponentialDistribution
    //
    // Parameterization: RATE (lambda), not scale — the mean is 1 / Rate.
    // Support is x >= 0. Precondition: Rate > 0.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exponential_distribution

    // The mean waiting time: the reciprocal of the rate.
    Mean(self: ExponentialDistribution): Number
        => 1.0 / self.Rate;

    // The variance: 1 / Rate^2.
    Variance(self: ExponentialDistribution): Number
        => 1.0 / self.Rate.Square;

    // The density: Rate * exp(-Rate * v) for v >= 0, zero for negative v.
    Pdf(self: ExponentialDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value < 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : self.Rate * (-self.Rate * value).Exp;

    // The cumulative probability: 1 - exp(-Rate * v) for v >= 0, zero for
    // negative v.
    Cdf(self: ExponentialDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value < 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : 1.0 - (-self.Rate * value).Exp;

    //==
    // # Gamma- and beta-family bodies
    //
    // The `IProbabilityDistribution` obligations for GammaDistribution,
    // BetaDistribution, ChiSquaredDistribution and StudentTDistribution. These four
    // share one shape: their Mean and Variance are elementary closed forms, while
    // every Pdf and Cdf goes through the special-function vocabulary of the
    // `numbers.library.plato` — `Gamma`/`LogGamma`, `Beta`, and the
    // regularized incomplete forms `RegularizedGammaP` and `RegularizedBeta`.
    // The accuracy of each body is bounded by the accuracy stated on those
    // functions (roughly 1e-12 relative on their primary domains).

    //==
    // # GammaDistribution
    //
    // Parameterization: SHAPE (k) and SCALE (theta) — theta is a scale, NOT a
    // rate; the rate form uses beta = 1 / theta. Support is x > 0.
    // Precondition: Shape > 0 and Scale > 0.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gamma_distribution

    // The mean: Shape * Scale.
    Mean(self: GammaDistribution): Number
        => self.Shape * self.Scale;

    // The variance: Shape * Scale^2.
    Variance(self: GammaDistribution): Number
        => self.Shape * self.Scale.Square;

    // The gamma density: x^(k-1) * exp(-x/theta) / (Gamma(k) * theta^k) for
    // x > 0, zero at and below zero (the x = 0 endpoint is taken as 0 even for
    // k < 1, where the true density diverges).
    Pdf(self: GammaDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : value.Pow(self.Shape - 1.0) * (-value / self.Scale).Exp
                / (Gamma(self.Shape) * self.Scale.Pow(self.Shape));

    // The gamma CDF: the regularized lower incomplete gamma P(k, x/theta) for
    // x > 0, zero at and below zero.
    Cdf(self: GammaDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : RegularizedGammaP(self.Shape, value / self.Scale);

    //==
    // # BetaDistribution
    //
    // Parameterization: shape parameters Alpha and Beta, support the closed
    // interval [0, 1]. Precondition: Alpha > 0 and Beta > 0.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beta_distribution

    // The mean: Alpha / (Alpha + Beta).
    Mean(self: BetaDistribution): Number
        => self.Alpha / (self.Alpha + self.Beta);

    // The variance: Alpha*Beta / ((Alpha+Beta)^2 * (Alpha+Beta+1)).
    Variance(self: BetaDistribution): Number
        => self.Alpha * self.Beta
         / ((self.Alpha + self.Beta).Square * (self.Alpha + self.Beta + 1.0));

    // The beta density: x^(a-1) * (1-x)^(b-1) / B(a, b) on (0, 1), zero
    // outside the open interval (the endpoints are taken as 0 even where the
    // true density diverges, i.e. a < 1 at 0 or b < 1 at 1).
    Pdf(self: BetaDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value <= 0.0 || value >= 1.0
            ? 0.0
            : value.Pow(self.Alpha - 1.0) * (1.0 - value).Pow(self.Beta - 1.0)
                / Beta(self.Alpha, self.Beta);

    // The beta CDF: the regularized incomplete beta I_x(a, b), clamped to 0
    // below the support and 1 above it.
    Cdf(self: BetaDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => value <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : value >= 1.0
                ? 1.0
                : RegularizedBeta(self.Alpha, self.Beta, value);
```
